title: Motivation and practical scaling
summary: Why production-scale scaling is harder than fitting a single loss-vs-compute curve; focus expands to initialization, learning rate, batch size and optimizers.

title: MiniCPM: invariance-oriented scaling
summary: MiniCPM-style tensor-program/muP parameterization, stable learning-rate transfer, critical batch scaling, WSD schedule, and Chinchilla-style sweeps.

title: DeepSeek: empirical hyperparameter scaling
summary: Grid-search optimal learning rate and batch size at several scales, fit scaling relationships, then combine WSD with Chinchilla analysis.

title: Recent public scaling recipes
summary: Qwen, Kimi K2, Hunyuan, LLaMA 3, and MiniMax examples show scaling laws used for hyperparameters, MoE sparsity, downstream prediction, and architecture choice.

title: StepFun study: learning rate and batch size
summary: Empirical hyperparameter landscapes; batch size mainly follows dataset size, LR depends on model/data, with robustness and dataset-transfer caveats.

title: Optimizer scaling and fair comparisons
summary: Optimizer gains depend on tuning and scale; compare at each optimizer’s own optimum and watch both total compute and token/parameter regime.

title: Muon
summary: Momentum plus Newton-Schulz approximate orthogonalization for matrix-valued updates; small-scale gains, scale dependence, and large-scale viability caveats.

title: Why muP
summary: Goal is hyperparameter transfer across width; CerebrasGPT evidence and the A1/A2 feature-learning conditions motivate the derivation.

title: muP derivation
summary: Deep-linear order-of-magnitude derivation of initialization and layerwise learning-rate scaling under A1/A2, including SGD and Adam rules.

title: muP stress tests and recap
summary: Modern components violate idealized assumptions; most tested variations transfer, while strong decoupled weight decay is a notable failure mode. Scaling remains useful but empirical and contingent.
